Use x_search to find distinct public X posts matching the query. Return only posts you found through the tool. Query label: clean_text_only
Query: Original text-only public posts about weather, travel, science, daily life, or technology. Require no attached photo, video, GIF, link preview, or quoted post.
Return at most 20 posts.
